name: Sendspin → On Open Pairing Window
description: An automation to perform when a pairing attempt is waiting to be confirmed on the device: a [static pairing code](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/#static-pairing-code) attempt while no pairing window is open, or a [dynamic pairing code](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/#dynamic-pairing-code) attempt after 20 wrong codes. Run [`sendspin.confirm_pairing_window`](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/#sendspin-confirm_pairing_window-action) to allow it.
